BrochureContent.Content:
2 Park Terrace (approx. 95 sqm ) is a bright and cosy three-bedroom mid-terrace residence ideally located along the sought-after Sea Road in Arklow. This property offers the added benefit of a separate two-bedroom detached guest house (approx. 43 sqm) to the rear, providing excellent flexibility for extended family accommodation, guest use, or potential rental income.
The main house accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall, a ground floor bedroom, a comfortable living room featuring an open fire with back boiler, and a spacious kitchen/dining area with fitted kitchen and integrated appliances. The ground floor also includes a utility area, shower room, and a sun room overlooking the rear garden. Upstairs there are two well-proportioned bedrooms with built-in wardrobes.
The detached guest house to the rear (2A Park Terrace) offers a self-contained living space with its own entrance and includes an open-plan kitchen/living area with solid fuel stove and back boiler, two bedrooms, and a fully tiled shower room.
Externally, the property benefits from a front garden with pathway and lawn areas, while the rear includes a paved walkway, gravel area, patio space, and a block-built shed. This unique property presents an excellent opportunity for those seeking additional accommodation or a potential home and income option in a convenient and established location close to Arklow town centre, the Arklow Bay Hotel, schools, shops, transport links, and the coastline.
